choices.reason: The paper calls the Revised arm a "secondary, diagnostic condition", so rule 1 leaves the Verbatim-versus-DALL-E-2 contrast, with raw and Z-scored estimates still tied. Rule 2 selects the raw Bradley–Terry specification reported in section 4.2.1 for the introduction’s contrast, because Appendix E.2 explicitly describes logo Z-scoring as a robustness check.
choices.locator: PDF pp. 3–4, section 1 (quoted sentence); p. 9, section 3.1 (DALL-E 3 denotes Verbatim); p. 18, section 4.2.1 (raw main estimate); p. 34, Appendix B.1.1 (Revised secondary); p. 54, Appendix E.2 (Z-scoring robustness).
choices.quote: Across both tasks, we find that participants assigned to DALL-E 3 produced significantly better outputs than those assigned to DALL-E 2, but that the sources of these gains depend on task structure.
